response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, and a CS bachelor's degree. However, the role specifically requires 8+ years building AI-driven solutions with vector databases, RAG architectures, and multi-agent frameworks on major cloud platforms — none of which are substantiated in his resume. His only AI-related exposure is a few months of MCP/agentic tooling work starting April 2025, far short of the depth and tenure required for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI role.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, deep software engineering experience across multiple languages and domains
Demonstrated technical leadership: staff-level titles, mentoring, workshops, and open-source project ownership
Current role touches MCP and agentic workflow infrastructure, showing some recent orientation toward AI tooling
concerns: No evidence of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions; GenAI exposure appears to be only a few recent months
No mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM evaluation/observability — all core required skills
No demonstrated experience with major cloud AI platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure AI services) or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI

key_factors.factor: Insufficient tenure in AI-specific development (required 8+ years)
Strong general staff-level engineering and leadership background
